title: 국립공업고등학교 설치령 / queue:ADDENDUM:35089:20241224:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Addenda to the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on the Establishment of Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province and the Creation of a Global Life Economy City <Presidential Decree No. 35089, December 24, 2024>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on December 27, 2024.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) Omitted.
(2) Part of the Decree on the Establishment of National Technical High Schools shall be amended as follows:
In the column for the location of Jeonbuk Mechanical Technical High School in the attached Table, "Jeollabuk-do" shall be replaced with "Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province".
(3) through (34) Omitted.
